newsitem.title: ROMANIA: SOCCER-DINAMO FINED, MUST PAY $20,000 DAMAGES.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DINAMO FINED, MUST PAY $20,000 DAMAGES.

text.p: Romania's soccer federation on Thursday fined Dinamo Bucharest $1,400 and ordered the club to pay damages estimated at $20,000 after their fans set fire to a stand in a Bucharest stadium at the weekend.
A federation statement said Dinamo must also play two matches behind closed doors after their fans destroyed some 700 seats before Saturday's match against arch-rivals Steaua Bucharest.
Fans found guilty of arson or public order offences could face jail sentences of up to 10 years.
Fifty-nine fans, most of them teenagers, remain in custody and 1,000 others have been fined between $3 and $17, in a country where the average monthly wage is less than $80.
Soccer violence has worsened considerably in Romania in the seven years since the end of communist rule.
Last month first division Universitatea Craiova were banned for four matches after their fans smashed car windscreens following a home defeat.
